remaining_gaps: Performance or non-performance of the dated commands in Executive Order 14144 as amended by Executive Order 14306 of June 6, 2025 is not shown by any held source: for example the NIST consortium by August 1, 2025, the update of SP 800-53 by September 2, 2025, the preliminary SSDF update by December 1, 2025 and final version within 120 days of publishing, the CISA post-quantum product category list and NSA and OMB TLS 1.3 requirements by December 1, 2025, and the artificial intelligence provisions with a November 1, 2025 date. A deadline is not an end, and an unperformed or unshown command cannot be recorded as terminated or confirmed operative without a held report, publication or agency notice for each.

The inventory of 134 draft clause rows pre-dates the renumbering and replacement of sections by Executive Order 14306 (striking 2(a)-(b), 3(a)-(b), 4(b)(iv), 4(d)(ii)-(iii) and section 5, and inserting new text); each struck clause needs its own terminated record (date June 6, 2025, express amendment) and each replaced clause a before-and-after record, which requires a reviewed inventory against the amended text that is not held in the packet as a single current text.

No held current-law text (U.S. Code or CFR) states the current form of the order; the held evidence is the continuation notice of March 24, 2026 (91 FR 15511), which names Executive Orders 14144 and 14306 among the steps in the cyber emergency.
